# Milestone Imports

> > Milestone Imports specializes in importing and distributing premium porphyry stone from Mexico and Patagonia for commercial and residential paving projects across North America.

Founded in 1998 by Miles Chaffee, Milestone Imports provides natural stone paving solutions including porphyry pavers, cobblestone, installation services, and technical support. The company serves clients throughout the United States and Canada with expertise in exterior design and permeable paving systems.
